name: QiYi Speed Void Cube 3x3 (Magnetic + UV) - Limited Edition
description: The QiYi Speed Void Cube 3x3 (Magnetic + UV) brings a fresh twist to a classic design with a fully hollow core and transparent, UV-coated pieces that shimmer in the light. It’s lightweight, colorful, and turns surprisingly well thanks to built-in magnets that help keep each layer aligned.
